name: Angel Beats! Track Zero
source:
A bonus chapter from the angel beats! series, this bonus includes a few short stories on the Girl's Dead Monster band and how their daily lives are shown in the series.

[From [url=http://www.renai.us/game/angel_beats_visual_novel_track_zero.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
《Angel Beats!》系列的附加章节，由数篇短篇组成，描绘Girls Dead Monster乐队成员在正篇中的日常生活。

[引自[url=http://www.renai.us/game/angel_beats_visual_novel_track_zero.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
